blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Monday passed on final reading a bill prohibiting children aged 13 and below from creating social media accounts while restricting access for those under 18. The chamber approved House Bill No. 10858, known as the Safe and Friendly Environment for Kids in Digital Spaces Act, with 287 lawmakers voting in favor and three against. However, a legislative showdown looms as the House and the Senate have passed differing versions of the bill.
